items.title: Trakt
items.text: Connect it with a code on your TV. What you watch is sent to Trakt.

items.title: Your library
items.text: Home shows every catalog, your whole library syncs, and a series moves on to its next episode.

items.title: Live
items.text: Live channels and sports play, with a LIVE badge.

items.title: Remote and screen
items.text: The pointer hides when idle, OK presses what you point at, and the TV's screen saver stays off during films.

items.title: More options
items.text: Subtitle position, skip intros on or off, more subtitle languages, and Greek.

note: New in this version: please try it and tell us if it works, in Settings > About > Share logs.
